sourceScope: Public PTT Stock-board Atom feed plus article pages, prospectively captured from the first verified live receipt onward.

narrativeTransforms.topicState: Frozen topic/phrase extraction version required; raw title/body remain canonical.
narrativeTransforms.stanceState: Bullish/bearish/uncertain stance may be derived only under a frozen classifier/manual-label contract; UNKNOWN is allowed.
narrativeTransforms.diffusionEdge: Later distinct-actor post/reply may link to an earlier narrative only if temporal order is valid and similarity/topic criteria were frozen before outcomes.
narrativeTransforms.amplification: Count/velocity of distinct-actor adoption may be studied, but raw post/reply volume is an attention primitive and cannot independently vote.

clocks.firstKnown: capturedAt is the conservative system-observable clock.
clocks.sourceTimes: Article publication/edit times and comment minute clocks are provenance; they do not backdate observability before first successful capture.
clocks.versioning: Append snapshots; never overwrite. Disappearance after capture becomes deletion/unavailable state.

ownershipFirewall.sharedPrimitiveRule: Same PTT receipt may support controls/transforms but never multiple additive selection votes.

falsification: Copied headline/news link alone is D17 propagation, not independent narrative diffusion.
Static theme membership is D09 taxonomy, not diffusion.
Price co-movement without text propagation is not narrative evidence.
A single prolific author or bot-like account can create volume without broad diffusion.
Deleted/edited content before first capture remains UNKNOWN.
l4Requirement: Post-freeze prospective narrative parents across independent dates with frozen topic/stance model, event/news controls, actor de-duplication and later outcome joins.
